function.name: memory_keep
function.description: Keep selected original materials. For gap only, add one short pending condition or question; it is a generated unresolved index, not a fact or plan.

pending.description: Required only for gap: one short unresolved condition or question. Forbidden for other categories.

function.name: memory_delete
function.description: Delete an active displayed record using its frozen M alias or real memory ID. The host resolves the target; accepted events and referenced snapshots remain.

function.name: memory_read_source
function.description: Read a frozen T/E/M alias, TASK/STATUS or shown real memory ID. Ambiguous identifiers are rejected. Return next_cursor unchanged; legacy material is not verified original experience.
